verdict.rationale: Segment's docs describe Reverse ETL, Functions, and Audiences as internally-scheduled sync/compute jobs, but there is no evidence of an API or interface letting an AI-native user programmatically create or manage arbitrary recurring jobs/workflows. The Public API only covers CRUD on sources/destinations/tracking plans, not job scheduling. Missing for 10: any documented scheduling API, cron-like job creation, or workflow orchestration surface for AI agents.
